reviews.text: Mike painted our 24 year old deck and made it look like new.  His painting and clean-up was meticulous, the job took 2 days with power washing and 2 coats of paint.

Whole team is fantastic! Mike went above and beyond to meet my expectations. The price quote he gave me was very reasonable. He also worked very fast and he was very neat. He gave me great advice on colors for my new apartment and his painting team were prompt, polite and did great job.
Mike is a true professional, I highly recommend him!

Mike did our 2 decks at our place. He power washed both of them, waited for dry process, and did 2 coats on both floor and railings. Two different colors, did a great job. Good guy, very reasonable. Will be using again in our future projects.
Mike did a great job painting my room. It was also last minute and he answered my call and we met the next day. He was generous with costs and also have excellent service!  Thank you Mike!
